ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: At the end of the 1970s, our country began family planning, the only child became a term of the era, and the so-called “421” kind of “inverted pyramid” family structure also became more and more common. <image1> The increase of “421 families” will increase the social burden in which aspect?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the cartoon, at the top there are multiple elderly people sitting or standing on a horizontal pole; below, two adults are strenuously supporting the horizontal pole, and beside them there is also a child who needs to be cared for. Overall, it presents an inverted-pyramid family structure of “four elderly people, two adults, one child.” Then reason: the “421 family” in the question stem refers to a couple made up of two only children needing to support four elderly people and raise one child. As this kind of family increases, pressures such as support, nursing, and medical care for the elderly population will increase in a concentrated way; therefore, what mainly increases is the burden in the aspect of social elderly care.

<image1>

The increase of “421 families” will increase the social burden in which aspect?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：漫画显示两个成年人承担上方多位老人，同时还要照顾一个孩子，形成倒金字塔式家庭负担。再结合题干所说“421家庭”的增多，判断这种结构的核心问题是老年人赡养压力变大。因此回答会加大的社会负担是社会养老负担。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：漫画中，上方有多位老人坐在或站在一根横杆上，下方由两个成年人吃力地支撑着横杆，旁边还有一个孩子需要照顾，整体呈现出“四个老人、两个成年人、一个孩子”的倒金字塔式家庭结构。再推理：题干中的“421家庭”指一对独生子女夫妻要赡养四位老人并抚养一个孩子。随着这种家庭增多，老年人口赡养、护理、医疗等压力会集中增加，因此加大的主要是社会养老方面的负担。
